action.message:
Implemented the feature contract in django/contrib/admin/options.py.

Change: Wrapped the list_editable bulk-edit processing in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view` with a database transaction. The loop that saves each changed form (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) is now enclosed in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`, so any error during the bulk edit rolls back all changes instead of leaving the database in an unexpected partial state.

`transaction` and `router` were already imported in the module, so no import changes were needed.

Verification: scoped_tests passed — 74 tests ran with 0 failures (selection: admin_changelist).
